profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Endava North America
profile.jobTitle: Backend Software Engineer | Developer Tooling & Content Platforms
profile.summary: As a Creative Technologist evolved into a dedicated Software Engineer, I bring over two decades of experience to advanced web development, with a deep specialization in frontend engineering. My journey has equipped me with a unique blend of innovative thinking and robust technical expertise. I am deeply passionate about crafting intuitive, engaging, and high-performance user experiences, consistently translating complex design concepts into clean, efficient, and impactful web applications. My comprehensive toolkit includes JavaScript, React, Angular, AEM, HTML5, CSS3, Node.js, and strong UX design principles, allowing me to build comprehensive digital solutions.

positions.title: Backend Software Engineer | Developer Tooling & Content Platforms
positions.description:
I build and improve backend tools and developer workflows for large content platforms, with a focus on making content pipelines more reliable and maintainable.
My work includes markdown-to-HTML conversion, automated content validation across repositories, and practical AI-assisted engineering workflows.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Agentic Workflows · Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) · Node.js · GitHub Copilot

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer (Engineer)
positions.description: Maintained and enhanced a complex, global, multilingual documentation project using Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Vanilla JavaScript, Sass, and Node.js, creating a seamless multilingual experience for global Adobe users. This involved overcoming challenges related to integrating content from multiple editors and sources, resulting in a redefined online brand presence with improved content accuracy.

positions.title: Frontend Developer (Senior Technician)
positions.locationName: Bogota, D.C., Capital District, Colombia · Hybrid
positions.description: Maintained and led the migration of a complex, global, multilingual documentation project from a Vanilla JavaScript approach to Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), utilizing technologies like Sass and Node.js. This resulted in improved content accuracy and streamlined workflows for global Adobe users, creating a seamless multilingual experience and redefining the online brand presence with enhanced platform stability and performance.

positions.title: Frontend Developer (Senior Technician)
positions.locationName: Bogota, D.C., Capital District, Colombia · Remote
positions.description: Contributed to the development and maintenance of Dynamic Boost, a React and Redux application, achieving a reduction in payment processing time. Collaborated with team members to refine user experience and construct reusable UI components, focusing on application performance enhancement through adherence to React best practices and ensuring high standards of code quality.

positions.title: Creative Technologist / Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
* Successfully delivered numerous custom applications, demos, and MVPs for diverse clients, including brands, political campaigns, startups, and advertising agencies.
* Defined project scope, managed development, and deployed solutions on secure AWS servers.
* Played a key role in integrating digital processes into marketing agencies, improving efficiency and client satisfaction.
* Built strong relationships with clients, consistently exceeding expectations and delivering high-quality results.

positions.title: Professional development
positions.description: I took a career break during the pandemic to study software development for two years, building on my more than 20 years of experience as a producer creating websites and digital experiences since 1997. By learning in-depth knowledge of all the technologies and languages I had previously used, I was able to solidify my empirical knowledge and gain a more conceptual understanding of software engineering.

positions.title: Digital Director / Creative Technologist
positions.description: Led the development and implementation of digital strategies for key clients, including Coca-Cola, Pfizer, and others, driving agency-wide adoption of digital processes and services. Successfully collaborated with creative teams to develop and execute impactful campaigns aligned with customer needs and budgets.  As a tech lead, spearheaded the research, design, and implementation of new production processes, optimizing resource allocation and facilitating the execution of innovative ideas.
positions.insights: Skills: Creative Technology · Digital Marketing · Digital Strategy · Strategic Planning

positions.title: Creative Technologist Director
positions.description: Led digital transformation initiatives at Sancho BBDO, spearheading the integration of technology into agency operations and client solutions.  Successfully trained employees on new technologies and adapted their roles to align with emerging digital trends. As Product Owner, facilitated communication between developers, creative teams, and clients to accelerate production and ensure alignment on project goals.

positions.title: Creative Tech Lead
positions.description: Skills: Full-Stack Development · Front-End Design · Web Development · User Experience Design (UED)

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Create websites and custom development using CMS like:

Expression Engine
Movable Type
Wordpress
Drupal
Participate in the design, develop and deliver on dedicate servers, load-balanced, and services like Linode.

Mostly LAMP solutions and frontend using CSS, HTML.

Doing websites for events, brands, financial services, and music artists.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Define the presence of the organization on the web, creating a website (called portal on those days) that includes all the efforts that WWF does in Colombia.

Technical documentation on webpages and PDFs
CD Roms
Audio (WWF Radio Colombia - a podcast on today terms)
Charts with data
Galleries (The most visited part of the website)
Screensavers, wallpapers according to the trends

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
We start creating the website and web presence for this new bank and in my role as a producer was:

New functionality for the bank website
Do a redesign of the Online Bank that was created using Netscape Enterprise Server and try to give a modern look with the complexity of the logic that the website has (java compiled on .web files)
Create an intranet (ASP / Oracle) for internal communication that grows with modules and integrate the technology and process that the bank has:
A Craightlist clone
Office of Foreign Assets Control Search tool to prevent do business with people on terrorism and drug traffic problems
An inventory module to track file and program changes on Bank computers, this tool was used by the Help Desk
A Screensaver module that changes the custom screensaver installed on each bank computer to put text, images, and animations.

positions.title: Co-Founder - Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Coding websites for clients on the US starting with simple plain HTML sites and later Macromedia Flash, we become recognized as a company that delivers solutions using Macromedia suite so we grew creating: Websites, Custom Screensavers, Multimedia CDs using Director and finally with the release of Dreamweaver Ultradev we start doing custom and more complex websites.

The company grows as 5 people between designers that code and developers with expertise on Movable Type, pearl, ASP and ASP.net (Myself on that part).

BrincaBrinca was always a design-centric company and ends (for me as a partner) when more custom development arrives.

projects.title: Lanzamiento programa de viajero frecuente LifeMiles
projects.description: Implementación del sitio web para el lanzamiento del programa de viajero frecuente de Avianca, implementación de flujo para explicarle a los diferentes usuarios categorizados de cómo sus beneficios cambiaban con el nuevo programa así como mostrar sus millas como se transformaban en LifeMiles en el nuevo plan.

projects.title: Federación Nacional de Cafeteros de Colombia / Colombian Coffee Growers Federation
projects.description: Implementación y migración del sitio web de la federación a un nuevo sistema de administrador de contenidos multilenguaje con opción de alojar y administrar todos los sitios de la federación, entre ellos cafedecolombia.com
